correctness.rationale: A three-state extension exactly encodes each complete third-sort type via free amalgamation. Double Holder on sign-restricted complete-bipartite supports yields the sharp coherent bound, with strictly nonproportional column or row functions when an orientation is mixed. Every mixed orientation has a two-edge mixed star, creating a cubic deficit equal to the number of directed 2-paths and strict loss at every larger support size. Independent expectation sum is exact; a low/high logarithmic partition yields summable relative excess O(n^-2), establishing L1 and almost sure limits. Standalone exact finite exhaustive checks corroborate small cases; no infinite inference rests on the code.
